annotations.title: Pre-check a rip-and-replace or E-Rate claim

description: Validate one claim with the Tensorust Clearinghouse program modules. program=scrp: one FCC rip-and-replace (Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Reimbursement Program) Form 5640 Part G invoice (application SCRP0001xxx, claimant_name, frn, vendor_name, vendor_ein, invoice_number, invoice_date, due_date, cost_incurred_date, claim_date, amount, category equipment|removal|disposal|internal_labor|professional|engineering|other, description, manufacturer, covered_obtained_date, disposal_cert, timesheets, billing tm|fixed, extension_requested, final_cert_date, uei) checked against the 126 granted applications (DA 22-774), each application's RRD deadline after DA 26-435 / DA 26-936, the claim and final-certification deadlines (DA 26-386), the Covered List and the named reimbursement holds. program=erate: one E-Rate BEAR or SPI invoice line (frn, form BEAR|SPI, claimant_name, ben, invoice_number, service_date, claim_date, undiscounted, amount, manufacturer) checked live against USAC Open Data (FRN status, Form 486, discount, commitment and disbursements, last date to invoice, Form 471 line-item manufacturers, C2 budget). Returns pass / warn / fail per rule with the record compared, the verdict and the payable amount. Nothing is recorded; duplicate and running-total rules need a console workspace (https://shop.tensorust.com/clearinghouse/console#programs). Free.
